guards: a Django change with a model bug, a missing migration and two view bugs (an order readable by any user, CSRF turned off on a POST) is reviewed as a Django change
amended: Copied from ../cases/django-model-view.json on 2026-10-08 to score this run with the scorer that needs words on every plant: each plant and side issue that had no mentions got them; no other field changed.

bugs.truth: total is a DecimalField, so self.total is a Decimal, and Decimal times the float 0.9 raises TypeError: every redemption of the welcome code fails. The fix is to multiply by Decimal("0.9") and round to two places.

The change adds the discount_code field but no migration, so the column does not exist and every query of Order fails once the code is deployed. The fix is a 0002 migration from makemigrations in the same change.

order_detail looks the order up by id alone, so any logged-in user can read any other user's order by changing the number in the URL. The fix is to filter by owner=request.user, as redeem and order_list do.
redeem changes an order on POST with CSRF protection turned off, so another site can make a logged-in user's browser redeem the code. The fix is to remove csrf_exempt.

extras.why: two redemptions at the same time can both pass the discount_code check; a real race the plant did not intend
